function.description: Create an x402 payment request (invoice): amount, purpose, expiry. Returns payment instructions the payer needs (recipient/chain/amount/id).
function.name: x402_invoice_x402_request

amount_usd.description: Invoice amount in USD (bounded by X402_INVOICE_MAX_USD)

asset_id.description: Which token this invoice is payable in (see `polyrob wallet asset list`). Unset = the chain's canonical USDC. An unknown id is REFUSED with the known ids, never swapped for another asset.

chain.description: Which chain to be paid on (e.g. base, solana). Unset = the instance default. Must match the asset's own chain — paying on the wrong one strands the funds.

payer_address.description: The correspondent payer's address/handle on that surface (pairs with payer_surface)

payer_contact.description: Free-form contact info for the payer (name/email/handle), shown on the invoice.

payer_hint.description: Deprecated alias for payer_contact (kept for back-compat; payer_contact takes precedence when both are given).

payer_surface.description: If invoicing a correspondent you already contacted, their surface (e.g. 'email'/'telegram'); settlement is delivered to you as DATA, not a command

purpose.description: What the payer is paying for (shown to them and audited)
